name: tenancy
title: Tenancy
description: A letting agent’s key cabinet on powder-coated grey: each listing is a plastic tag on a numbered zinc hook, status, title and rent typed on its paper insert; lilac free, amber agreed, grey gone.

tokens.--font-body: body text, headings, tag titles: humanist sans
tokens.--font-label: typed labels: plates, menu, status, prices, facts
tokens.--text-xs: status words, facts, hook numbers, labels
tokens.--text-l: standfirsts, price on a listing page
tokens.--color-cabinet: inside of the cabinet, code, footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, current menu line, quote rule
tokens.--color-paper: paper: inserts, plates, inquiry box, photo borders
tokens.--color-insert-muted: addresses, facts, labels, dashed lines on paper
tokens.--color-violet: call button, label plate, skip link, e-mail link
tokens.--color-zinc-dark: shade of hooks, split rings, outlines
tokens.--color-tag-free: lilac tag: For sale, To let, Available, others
tokens.--color-tag-agreed: amber tag: Under offer, Let agreed
tokens.--color-tag-clear: clear tag: no status; links listed on the home page
tokens.--color-sheen: light on tag corners and edges
tokens.--color-shade: small shadows: rails, cabinet, lug hole
tokens.--shadow-tag: shadow of tags, inquiry box, photos
tokens.--gap: space between tags on a rail
tokens.--tap: minimum height of links and buttons
